worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.summary: Slip past at a speed the eye cannot follow and swap held items only on the contact that actually happens. Almost no wind-up and a short cooldown, at the cost of having to close in. You may cast it with no target as a pure dash; the swap only happens with the first body you really hit, and hitting an ally or a wall stops you in place. Faster individuals slip further and trade more cleanly.
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.use.0: Close in and take the foe's item
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.use.1: Hand a burden to the foe in a close scuffle
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.use.2: Cast with no target as a short dash, or pass through with Pass through
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.description: Move up to %1$s blocks along your aim: only the first enemy body really hit swaps held items with you, hitting an ally or being blocked by a wall stops you, and meeting nobody is just a pass.
A %1$s wind-up and %2$s blocks per tick, then %3$s to gather yourself and a %4$s cooldown.
On hitting an enemy it is dragged about %2$s blocks along the slip; with Pass through you keep advancing tick by tick, stopping at a body or a wall (never through it), for about %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.through.on: Pass through: after the swap you keep advancing tick by tick, stopping at a body or a wall (never straight through one); distance above.
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.through.off: Stop on contact: after the swap you settle at the target's side, a steadier landing that never leaves its reach.
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it costs %4$s PP to slip out, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.growth.0: At level %1$s the slip reaches %2$s blocks and the cooldown becomes %3$s seconds.
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.growth.1: At level %1$s the slip reaches %2$s blocks at %3$s blocks per tick.
On: after the swap you keep advancing tick by tick, stopping at a body or a wall (never straight through one); the distance is in Pass-through distance. Off: you stop on contact at the target's side, a steadier landing that never leaves its reach.
Only slip in within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to slip in. Off: it only slips when the target is already in reach.
Only when there is an item to trade

On: only used when the target or the caster holds an item and the target does not refuse the exchange. Off: when both sides are empty it is still only a low-scoring pure dash, never counted as a trade.
worldcombat.skill.switcheroo.description: It can be cast with no target as a pure dash and is never refused just for the original target's ability. A target with Sticky Hold or the like only fails the swap when you actually reach its body, and the move is a pass instead; the same holds if the user is embargoed.
